title: Hopeful
body:
This app addresses the problems that I face every day.

Issues 
- It is overwhelming to set up tasks in the beginning. Based on my goals (from the first few screens), it would be great to see 3 complete day schedules. Then adding and subtracting would not be so overwhelming. 
- The options for repeating tasks should be expanded. For example, add “repeat hourly” or (2,4,6,8,10 hours) for tasks such as “drink water”. And add several weekly options (2,4,6,8,10 weeks) for tasks like “haircut or groom dog”.
